meta.name: smart-explore
meta.description: Token-optimized structural code search using tree-sitter AST parsing. Use instead of reading full files when you need to understand code structure, find functions, or explore a codebase efficiently.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AST解析快速搜索代码结构，替代逐文件阅读
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要在不熟悉的代码库中快速找到函数或结构
copy.tagline_en: Search code structure quickly with AST parsing, replacing full file reads
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly find functions or structures in unfamiliar codebases

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会使用 smart_search、smart_outline、smart_unfold 三个工具来探索代码。它会先搜索代码结构，再按需展开具体函数，而不是直接读取整个文件。
howto.when: 当你想了解代码结构、查找函数或高效浏览代码库时，Claude 会优先使用这些工具，而不是 Grep、Glob 或 Read。

say.text: 帮我搜索项目中所有与 shutdown 相关的函数。
展开 worker-service.ts 文件中的 shutdown 函数。
给我 services/worker-service.ts 的文件结构。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses smart_search, smart_outline, and smart_unfold to explore code. It first searches for structure, then expands specific functions on demand, instead of reading entire files.
howto.when_en: When you need to understand code structure, find functions, or efficiently browse a codebase, Claude will prioritize these tools over Grep, Glob, or Read.

say_en.text: Search for all functions related to shutdown in the project.
say_en.note: Claude will call smart_search to return matching symbols and file structure.

say_en.text: Expand the shutdown function in worker-service.ts.
say_en.note: Claude will outline the file then unfold that function.

say_en.text: Show me the structure of services/worker-service.ts.
say_en.note: Claude will call smart_outline to list functions and classes.
